changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led QA Crew proposal from exact-build journey evidence to a reviewed release gate, with optional flake investigation.

title: Release Candidate to Reviewed Gate
description: Join required journey attempts and optional flake investigation to an exact-build release quality decision with separate status publication evidence.
setup_prompt: Use Release Candidate to Reviewed Gate as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing QA Crews, release and build identity, required suite policy, test runner and evidence policy, flake history, gate owner, and status destination. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact artifact validators, an optional bounded flake branch, and one manual release candidate. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not run tests, mark a gate passed, publish status, merge, deploy, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Release or PR ID, exact SHA, build artifact, environment and cutoff
Required suites, expected journey revision, pass/fail/needs-review rules and exceptions
Authorized CI, browser attempt records and evidence retention rules
QA investigator, gate reviewer and status authority
Retry, isolation, quarantine and stability decision rules
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated build event

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing QA Crews with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: CI or test-result source
recommended_tools.purpose: Read required suite attempts and tested SHA, build and environment

recommended_tools.name: Browser runner or evidence export
recommended_tools.purpose: Run approved journeys and retain attempt-level diagnostics

recommended_tools.name: Repository and release source
recommended_tools.purpose: Read candidate SHA, build artifact and gate policy

recommended_tools.name: Release status destination
recommended_tools.purpose: Publish an exact approved gate and retain provider receipt through a separate route

pulse_focus.label: Release quality decision
focus_areas: Whether required suites ran against the exact candidate
Whether failures and flakes retain diagnostic evidence and owner decisions
review_when: A candidate build changes, a required attempt finishes, flake evidence changes, or the gate owner decides

outputs: Reviewed QA Crew roster and exact candidate scope
Optional bounded flake investigation with retained failures
Reviewed release quality brief with full required-suite matrix
Provider-confirmed status when separately authorized and manual route evidence
